name: stakeholder-tier-router
description: Blocks task generation until all three tier approval checkboxes in walkthroughs/*.md are checked. Routes failure messages with tier-specific guidance.
notes: Set feature_path in your harness (e.g. specs/001-my-feature). Paths are relative to repository root. Adapt matcher to your agent product. Use `command` on POSIX, `windows_command` on Windows; both scripts have identical exit semantics (0=ok, 2=incomplete).
